mechanism.claim: During a volatile BTC block, clean same-direction cash and perpetual paths with accelerating spot BTC volume but inefficient perpetual displacement identify a cash-led directional handoff that should continue for six hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed spot and perpetual final-two-hour returns
mechanism.why_distinct: CVEH uses cross-venue path-efficiency asymmetry plus relative base-volume acceleration onset. It is not a cash-basis level/change, spot participation level, taker/trade-count signal, spot-price underreaction gap, or any prior diagnostic control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse cross-venue efficiency-handoff onset on eight-hour boundaries is absent from Gross9

feature_contract.price: 480 exact unique coherent positive BTCUSDT 1m OHLC rows independently from bars_binance and bars_binance_spot; no imputation
feature_contract.volume: finite strictly positive BTC base volume from both venues; late=[D-2h,D), early=[D-4h,D-2h)
feature_contract.late_return: log(last close/first open) over each venue final two hours
feature_contract.late_path_length: sum absolute close-to-close log returns within each final-two-hour path plus absolute log(first close/first open), exactly 120 increments
feature_contract.volume_acceleration: log(late 2h base-volume sum / early 2h base-volume sum) per venue
feature_contract.handoff: spot volume acceleration minus perpetual volume acceleration
feature_contract.variation: sum 479 squared perpetual close-to-close log returns
feature_contract.causal_ranks: strict-prior midrank over at most270 source-valid blocks minimum180 current excluded
feature_contract.primary_state: variation_rank>=.65, same strict nonzero late-return signs, spot_efficiency_rank>=.80, perpetual_efficiency_rank<=.50, handoff_rank>=.75
feature_contract.onset: current primary_state true and immediately preceding eight-hour primary_state not true; invalid preceding state counts not true

clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not input; exact PnL settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity exact funding 6bp/10bp per side strict held favorable-then-adverse 5m MDD full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: new cash-efficiency and base-volume migration mechanism specified before incidence/outcomes

stopping_rule: freeze prereg/source support/novelty/economics; terminal first failure; no source/rank/onset/side/hold/clock/subset/control repair
